nodes.title: Dial gate G4 refuses 'already_paid' (blocked, not retried) when intake's paidSinceImport (aaf502d: a verified gateway payment matched by the workspace's record key, not more than 24 h older than the person's record of that key) finds one, for campaign, API and retry attempts only; a callback the person asked for, a member's single call, a test and a transfer still go. The member reads 'They already paid ₹14,250 through Razorpay on 30 December, after this list was imported, so they are not called.' A list imported more than a day after the payment opens the next cycle. On a passing G4 the gate's note records paidChecked, and the call page's 'Why this call was allowed' line adds 'no payment from them has come in since this list was imported'.
nodes.rationale: Intake's payment webhooks seam, agreed 2026-10-24; G4 rather than a new G13 keeps the 12-check trace stable.
nodes.reverse_if: A paid person is called anyway on staging (then the record-key match or the 24 h margin is wrong), or businesses need paid people called for a receipt confirmation (then a per-campaign opt-out of this check).
evidence: product/tests/campaigns.test.ts 'G4 already_paid': an API attempt refused with the words above and outcome blocked; callback and single calls allowed; a newer list allowed

events.details: Wired; full suite on a fresh DB 891/893 with 1 skipped (an intake test waiting on workspace start-over) and 1 failure in telephony's tests/telephony-verify.test.ts ('the code expired'), which also fails 1 in 2 standalone: a flake in telephony's own test, reported to the telephony builder, not this change.
